metadata.post_processing_scripts:
[DiagonalZHop]\
extruder_nb = 1\
\
[CreateThumbnail]\
width = 128\
height = 128\
\
[MixHopper]\
extrusion_interval = 2000.0\
mix_gcode = MIX_HOPPER\
\

machine_end_gcode.default_value:
;--- Penrose 600 IDEX Pellet Extruder End GCode ---
M104 T0 S0 ;nozzle 0 heater off
M104 T1 S0 ;nozzle 1 heater off
M104 H0 S0 ;barrel heater 0 off
M104 H1 S0 ;barrel heater 1 off
M140 S0 ;heated bed heater off
G91 ;relative positioning
G1 Z+0.5 E-2 F3000 ;move Z up a bit and retract slightly
G28 X0 Y0 ;move X/Y to home
M84 ;steppers off
M107 ;fan off
G90 ;absolute positioning

machine_start_gcode.value:
';Machine Model: {machine_name}
;Nozzle Size: T0 ' + str(extruderValue(0, 'machine_nozzle_size')) + ' T1 ' + str(extruderValue(1, 'machine_nozzle_size')) + '
;Sliced at: {day} {date} {time}
;Print mode: {print_mode}
;--- Penrose 600 IDEX Pellet Extruder Start GCode ---
M140 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Heat build surface
' + ("M104 T1 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 1}" if extruderValue(1, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 1}") + "	;Heat nozzle 1
" + "M104 H1 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 1}	;Heat barrel 1
" + "M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait until bed temperature reached
" + "M109 T1 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 1}" if extruderValue(1, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 1}") + "	;Wait for nozzle 1
" + "M109 H1 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 1}	;Wait for barrel 1
" if print_mode == 'singleT1' else '') + ("M104 T0 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Heat nozzle 0
" + "M104 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Heat barrel 0
" + "M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait until bed temperature reached
" + "M109 T0 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Wait for nozzle 0
" + "M109 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Wait for barrel 0
" if print_mode == 'singleT0' else '') + ("M104 T0 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Heat nozzle 0
" + "M104 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Heat barrel 0
" + "M104 T1 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 1}" if extruderValue(1, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 1}") + "	;Heat nozzle 1
" + "M104 H1 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 1}	;Heat barrel 1
" + "M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait until bed temperature reached
" + "M109 T0 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Wait for nozzle 0
" + "M109 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Wait for barrel 0
" + "M109 T1 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 1}" if extruderValue(1, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 1}") + "	;Wait for nozzle 1
" + "M109 H1 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 1}	;Wait for barrel 1
" if print_mode == 'dual' else '') + ("M104 T0 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Heat nozzle 0
" + "M104 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Heat barrel 0
" + "M104 T1 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Heat nozzle 1
" + "M104 H1 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Heat barrel 1
" + "M190 S{material_bed_temperature_layer_0} 	;Wait until bed temperature reached
" + "M109 T0 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Wait for nozzle 0
" + "M109 H0 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Wait for barrel 0
" + "M109 T1 " + ("S{material_print_temperature, 0}" if extruderValue(0, 'material_print_temperature_layer_0') == 0 else "S{material_print_temperature_layer_0, 0}") + "	;Wait for nozzle 1
" + "M109 H1 S{material_barrel_temperature_layer_0, 0}	;Wait for barrel 1
" if print_mode == 'mirror' or print_mode == 'duplication' else '') + 'G21 		;metric values
G90 		;absolute positioning
M107 		;start with the fan off
G28 Z0 		;move Z to min endstops
G28 X0 Y0 	;move X/Y to min endstops
G1 X0 Y0 Z5 F5000 	;safety Z axis movement

G29 	;Auto Bed Level
M500 	;Save Bed Level
' + ("
; --- T0 Pellet Purge (off-bed X=-20 Y=-5) ---
T0
G0 X-20 Y-5 Z5 F10000	;Move to T0 purge position
G0 Z3 F500	;Lower to purge height
G92 E0	;Reset extruder
G1 E500 F500	;Purge 500mm
G1 E1000 F1000	;Purge 500mm
G92 E0	;Reset extruder
G0 Z5 F500	;Raise Z
" if print_mode != 'singleT1' else "") + ("
; --- T1 Pellet Purge (off-bed X=620 Y=-5) ---
T1
G0 X620 Y-5 Z5 F10000	;Move to T1 purge position
G0 Z3 F500	;Lower to purge height
G92 E0	;Reset extruder
G1 E500 F500	;Purge 500mm
G1 E1000 F1000	;Purge 500mm
G92 E0	;Reset extruder
G0 Z5 F500	;Raise Z
" if print_mode != 'singleT0' else "") + ("T0
" if print_mode != 'singleT1' else "") + '
{print_mode_gcode}
G4 P1
G4 P2
G4 P3

G1 X0 Y0 Z5 F5000	;Move to start position
G92 E0	;zero the extruded length
'

max_flow_acceleration.value: 0.5 if machine_nozzle_size <= 0.6 else 0.75 if machine_nozzle_size <= 1.0 else 1.0 if machine_nozzle_size <= 2.0 else 1.5

speed_print.value: min(80, int(max_volumetric_flow_rate / (layer_height * line_width))) if max_volumetric_flow_rate > 0 else 60
